items.example: The suffix -age forms sewerage from sewer.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -age 由 sewer 构成 sewerage。

items.example: Sewerage names the whole network.
items.exampleCN: sewerage 指整套网络。

items.example: Sewage names the water inside the sewers.
items.exampleCN: sewage 指管道里的污水。

items.example: Sew gives the unrelated stitching sewer.
items.exampleCN: sew 给出无关的「缝纫者」义。

definition_zh: 轴；柄；竖井；电梯井；一束光（或光柱）；挖苦话；抨击
definition_en: a long thin rod or handle, a deep vertical passage through the ground or a building, or a narrow beam of light
core_image: 一根笔直细长的杆子，从地面直插到地底深处
scene: 工程师站在井口往下看，只见一根笔直的通道通向黑暗。The engineers lowered a camera down the shaft to check for cracks.
sceneCN: 这里 shaft 是「竖井」（第 2 个义项：从地面垂直深入的深通道）；句意：工程师们把一台摄像机放进竖井，检查是否有裂缝。

derivatives.zh: 有柄的；有轴的（尤见于复合词，如 long-shafted）；作动词延伸义时指「被人坑了」
轴系；传动装置（机械术语，由动词或名词加 -ing 构成）

senses.title: A long narrow rod or handle
senses.definition: a long narrow rod, often one that a tool or weapon is fitted to, such as an arrow or a hammer
senses.definitionCN: 细长直挺的杆子，常作为工具或武器的柄，如箭杆、锤柄
senses.example: He fitted a new shaft to the axe.
senses.exampleCN: 他给斧子装了一根新柄。
senses.why: The old English word describes the long straight stem of a weapon or tool, and that straight woody shape is the original picture.
senses.whyCN: 古英语这个词描述武器或工具上笔直的长柄，这个笔直的木杆形状就是最初的画面。

senses.title: A deep vertical passage
senses.definition: a long narrow passage that goes straight down through rock or soil, such as a mine shaft or an air shaft
senses.definitionCN: 笔直向下穿过岩层或土壤的狭长通道，如矿井竖井或通风井
senses.example: The mine shaft was closed after the accident.
senses.exampleCN: 矿难之后，这座矿井竖井被封闭了。
senses.why: A long straight stem seen from above becomes a long straight tunnel seen from outside, so the rod turns into a hole.
senses.whyCN: 从上往下看的长直杆子，换成从外面看，就成了一条长直的隧道，于是杆变成了洞。

senses.title: The space inside a building for a lift
senses.definition: the enclosed vertical space inside a building in which a lift or an elevator travels
senses.definitionCN: 建筑物内部供电梯上下运行的封闭垂直空间
senses.example: The lift stopped halfway up the shaft.
senses.exampleCN: 电梯在井道里停在了半路。
senses.why: Buildings borrow the mine image: a straight vertical channel in which a cabin climbs and falls.
senses.whyCN: 建筑物借用了矿井的画面：一条笔直的垂直通道，轿厢在里面升降。

senses.title: A narrow beam of light
senses.definition: a thin beam of light that falls through a small opening or a gap
senses.definitionCN: 从小孔或缝隙射进来的细窄光柱
senses.example: A shaft of sunlight fell across the floor.
senses.exampleCN: 一束阳光斜照在地板上。
senses.why: A beam of light has the same long straight shape as a rod, and the likeness of shape carries the word into the sense of light.
senses.whyCN: 光柱的形状与杆子一样细长笔直，正是形状上的相似把这个词带进了「光」的义项。

senses.title: A long thin part of a machine
senses.definition: a long narrow rotating part of a machine that carries power from one part to another
senses.definitionCN: 机械中细长旋转、用于传递动力的部件
senses.example: The drive shaft was worn and needed replacing.
senses.exampleCN: 传动轴磨损了，需要更换。
senses.why: Engineering keeps the rod: the machine shaft is a straight bar that turns, and the name moves from handle to rotating bar.
senses.whyCN: 工程领域保留了「杆」这个概念：机械轴就是一根直挺、可转动的杆，名字从手柄转到转动杆。

senses.title: A hit or a sarcastic remark
senses.definition: a sharp or cutting remark aimed at a person, spoken as if an arrow were loosed at them
senses.definitionCN: 针对某人的尖锐刻薄话，仿佛朝他射出一支箭
senses.example: The critic aimed a shaft of irony at the minister.
senses.exampleCN: 评论家朝部长射出一句讽刺的利箭。
senses.why: The wooden stem of an arrow gives the metaphor: a cruel remark is a shaft that flies and strikes.
senses.whyCN: 箭的木杆给出了这个比喻：伤人的话就是一支飞出去、射中人的箭。

senses.title: To cheat or trick someone
senses.definition: to cheat or deceive someone, especially by treating them unfairly
senses.definitionCN: 欺骗或捉弄某人，常指让人吃亏
senses.example: I think we have all been shafted on that deal.
senses.exampleCN: 我觉得在那笔交易里我们全被骗了。
senses.why: The slang sense turns a spear thrust into a crooked deal, as if the shaft were thrust into someone.
senses.whyCN: 这个俚语义把「刺出的长矛」变成了「设局害人」，仿佛长矛捅进了某人身上。

intro.en: Shaft comes from Old English sceaft, a long rod, and the same old root gives shaft in many Germanic languages.
intro.cn: shaft 来自古英语 sceaft（长杆），同一古老词根在多种日耳曼语言里都有对应词。

items.en: A reconstructed form such as skaftaz, a rod or a shaft, is generally given as the older stage.
items.cn: 一般认为更早的阶段是重构形式 skaftaz（杆、轴）。

items.en: Sceaft means a spear shaft, an arrow stem, or a handle.
items.cn: sceaft 指矛杆、箭杆或手柄。

items.en: Schaft keeps the weapon and tool senses as spelling settles.
items.cn: 拼写逐渐固定时，schaft 保留了武器与工具的义项。

items.en: The word extends to a hole dug straight down, because a mine passage is long and straight like a stem.
items.cn: 词义扩展到垂直挖下的洞，因为矿井通道像长杆一样细长笔直。

items.en: Engineering, architecture, and poetry take the straight shape for machine rods, lift wells, and beams of light.
items.cn: 工程、建筑和诗歌都取用这种笔直形状，指机械轴、电梯井和光束。

note.en: Shaft is the straight thin thing, whether a rod, a hole, a beam, or a barbed remark; the words around it split by shape and by field.
note.cn: shaft 的核心是「细长笔直之物」，可以是杆、洞、光束，也可以是带刺的话；周边的词则按形状与领域分化。

entries.definition: a bundle of cut corn or papers, only looks and sounds like shaft and has a different root
entries.definitionCN: 一捆；一沓（谷子或纸张）；只是拼写与读音相近，词源不同

entries.definition: sounding and feeling close to shaft though it comes from the verb shift, meaning sly or evasive
entries.definitionCN: 狡猾的；滑头的。听感和字形都接近 shaft，但来自动词 shift，意为「推诿、避开」

entries.definition: to cut hair close to the skin, from a different old root for cutting
entries.definitionCN: 剃；刮；来自另一个表示「切削」的古词根

entries.definition: the rod on which a wheel turns
entries.definitionCN: 轮轴；车轴

entries.definition: a ray of light or a long piece of timber
entries.definitionCN: 光束；横梁

entries.definition: a deep hole dug to reach water
entries.definitionCN: 水井；深坑

normalIntro.en: Shaft keeps one shape through every sense: something long, narrow, and straight.
normalIntro.cn: shaft 在所有义项里都保持同一个形状：细、长、直。

normal.en: An arrow shaft is the straight stem of the arrow.
normal.cn: arrow shaft 就是箭上那根笔直的箭杆。

normal.en: A mine shaft is a stem dug into the earth, and an elevator shaft is one built in a tower.
normal.cn: mine shaft 是扎进地里的杆状洞，elevator shaft 是楼里做出来的竖井。

normal.en: A drive shaft turns in a car and carries power to the wheels.
normal.cn: drive shaft 在车里转动，把动力传给车轮。

normal.en: Compare axle: an axle is a rod in a wheel, a shaft often carries power along a line.
normal.cn: 对比 axle：axle 是轮子上的轴，shaft 常指沿直线传力的轴。

normal.en: Watch the spelling pair sheaf and shaft: one is a bundle, one is a rod.
normal.cn: 注意 sheaf 与 shaft 这一对：一个是「捆」，一个是「杆」。

abstract.en: Draw a long straight pencil line from sky to floor: that is a shaft and a beam at once.
abstract.cn: 从天空画一条笔直的线到地面：它既是杆也是光束。

abstract.en: Imagine a lift falling slowly down a deep round well of concrete.
abstract.cn: 想象电梯沿一个深深的圆形混凝土井缓缓下降。

abstract.en: Picture an arrow leaving the string and piercing a shield: a shaft becomes a sharp remark.
abstract.cn: 想象箭离开弓弦刺中盾牌：杆就变成了刻薄话。

examples.en: The miners descended the shaft in a small cage.
examples.cn: 矿工们乘着一个小吊笼下到竖井里。

examples.en: A shaft of light cut through the dusty window.
examples.cn: 一束光从满是灰尘的窗户透进来。

examples.en: The long drive shaft transfers power from the engine to the rear wheels.
examples.cn: 长传动轴把动力从发动机传给后轮。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「下扶梯」——下扶梯时正好看到一条笔直的竖井，一根杆子从中穿过；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古英语 sceaft（长杆、矛杆）← 重构形式 skaftaz（杆）→ 中古英语 schaft → 现代英语 shaft；由「细长笔直的杆」引申出竖井、轴、光束、挖苦话。

sensesIntro.en: Shaft begins as a straight rod, then the straight shape is read as a tunnel, a rotating axle, or a beam of light, and finally as a arrow-like remark or a sly trick.
sensesIntro.cn: shaft 从「笔直的杆」起步，然后这种笔直形状被读作隧道、转动轴或光束，最后读作像箭一样的刻薄话或阴招。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a straight narrow rod going deep into the ground.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根细长笔直的杆，深深插进地里。

branches.en: The handle and arrow stem keep the original rod.
branches.cn: 手柄与箭杆保留最初的杆形。

branches.en: The straight rod seen from outside becomes a mine well or a lift well.
branches.cn: 从外面看的直杆，就成了矿井或电梯井。

branches.en: Light with the same straight shape becomes a beam.
branches.cn: 形状同样笔直的光就成了光柱。

branches.en: The machine axle keeps the rod but adds rotation.
branches.cn: 机械轴保留杆形，增添了转动。

branches.en: An arrow-like remark and a sly trick build on the flying shaft.
branches.cn: 像箭一样的话与阴招都建立在「飞出去的杆」上。

intro.en: Shaft is a native Germanic word with no Latin affixes, so its family grows through compounds such as drive shaft and air shaft.
intro.cn: shaft 是日耳曼语本族词，没有拉丁词缀，它的家族靠 drive shaft、air shaft 这类复合词扩展。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin origin here, and no Latin cousin of shaft, so this part is left empty on purpose.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁来源，也没有 shaft 的拉丁同族词，因此这一节故意留空。

items.example: Shaft is the base word.
items.exampleCN: shaft 是基础词。

items.meaning: more than one rod or well
items.example: The plural is shafts.
items.exampleCN: 复数形式是 shafts。

items.meaning: tricked, or fitted with a shaft
items.example: Shafted carries the verb sense.
items.exampleCN: shafted 承担动词义。

items.meaning: the system of shafts in a machine
items.example: Shafting names the parts together.
items.exampleCN: shafting 统称这些部件。

items.example: A drive shaft links engine and wheels.
items.exampleCN: drive shaft 连接发动机与车轮。

items.meaning: a passage that brings fresh air
items.example: An air shaft keeps tunnels breathable.
items.exampleCN: air shaft 让隧道保持通风。

items.meaning: a vertical tunnel in a mine
items.example: A mine shaft goes straight down.
items.exampleCN: mine shaft 笔直向下。

items.example: A light shaft appears in haze.
items.exampleCN: 在雾气中能看到光柱。

definition_zh: 棚屋；简陋的小屋；贫民窟；水手号子（shanty 亦作 chantey，指引水歌）
definition_en: a small roughly built hut or cabin, a poor and crowded district of such huts, or a sailors work song with a strong rhythm
core_image: 铁皮和木板钉成的歪斜小屋，风一吹就吱呀作响
scene: 风暴过后，海岸边一排用旧木板搭成的小屋全被吹歪了。Along the shore, families still live in wooden shanties.
sceneCN: 这里 shanty 是「棚屋」（第 1 个义项：用废料草草搭成的简陋小屋）；句意：岸边至今仍有一户户人家住在木棚屋里。

pos.zh: 水手号子；船工号子（亦作 chantey）

derivatives.zh: shanty 加 town 构成的复合词，指大片棚屋聚成的贫民住区
形容像棚屋一样低矮、粗糙、拼凑而成的样子
水手号子的另一拼写，与 shanty 的号子义同源异形

senses.title: A roughly built hut
senses.definition: a small roughly built hut or cabin made of cheap materials such as wood, tin, or boards
senses.definitionCN: 用木头、铁皮或木板等廉价材料草草搭成的小屋或棚子
senses.example: The old man lived in a shanty by the river.
senses.exampleCN: 那位老人住在河边一间棚屋里。
senses.why: The word comes from Canadian and American French chantier, a workers camp or timber yard, and the rough hut of such a camp is the first sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个词源自加拿大与美国的法语 chantier（工人营地或木料场），营地里的粗陋木屋就是第一个义项。

senses.title: A crowded poor district
senses.definition: a poor and crowded part of a town made up of such huts
senses.definitionCN: 由这类棚屋构成的、贫穷拥挤的城镇区域
senses.example: A shanty grew up on the edge of the mining town.
senses.exampleCN: 矿区小镇的边缘长出了一片棚户区。
senses.why: A single hut repeated many times becomes a whole district, so the word widens from one cabin to a place where people live.
senses.whyCN: 一间小屋重复成许多间，就变成一整片区域，于是词义从一间棚屋扩大为一个居住地带。

senses.title: A sailors work song
senses.definition: a rhythmical song sung by sailors while working, also spelled chantey or chanty
senses.definitionCN: 水手干活时唱的有节奏的歌，也拼作 chantey 或 chanty
senses.example: The crew pulled the ropes in time with a sea shanty.
senses.exampleCN: 船员们随着水手号子的节拍拉动绳索。
senses.why: A separate word, probably from French chanter, to sing, shares the spelling by accident of history, not by shared origin.
senses.whyCN: 这是另一个词，一般认为来自法语 chanter（唱），它与棚屋义的拼写相同，是历史巧合而非共同来源。

intro.en: Shanty, the hut, comes from North American French chantier, which named a lumber camp and its rough buildings; the song word is separate.
intro.cn: shanty（棚屋）来自北美法语 chantier，指伐木营地及其简陋建筑；表示船歌的词则是另一回事。

items.en: Cantherius names a trestle or a support, and it is generally proposed as an older link to the French word.
items.cn: cantherius 指支架或支座，一般认为它是通向法语词的更早环节。

items.en: Chantier means a workshop, a lumber yard, or a building site, a place where timber is cut and stacked.
items.cn: chantier 意为作坊、木料场或工地，即砍伐和堆放木料的地方。

items.en: In Canada chantier names a lumber camp with its rough log cabins and sheds.
items.cn: 在加拿大，chantier 指伐木营地，连同粗糙的原木小屋和工棚。

items.en: English speakers borrow the camp hut as shanty, first in logging and mining country.
items.cn: 英语使用者借入营地的棚屋，读作 shanty，起初流行于伐木区与矿区。

items.en: The word widens to a poor crowded district and to temporary housing shelters.
items.cn: 词义扩大为贫穷拥挤的街区，也指临时安置的简易住房。

items.en: The sailors song, also spelled chantey, is usually traced to French chanter, to sing, and is not the same word.
items.cn: 水手号子也拼作 chantey，一般认为源于法语 chanter（唱），与棚屋义并非同一个词。

note.en: Shanty is a hut and a district of huts, close to shack and slum; its singing homograph is a different word entirely.
note.cn: shanty 既是棚屋，也是一片棚屋区，与 shack、slum 相邻；而表示唱歌的同形词则完全是另一个词。

entries.definition: a sailors song, usually spelled chantey in dictionaries
entries.definitionCN: 水手号子，词典里常拼作 chantey，与 shanty 的号子义同词异形

entries.definition: another spelling of the sailors song sense
entries.definitionCN: 水手号子的另一拼写，指同一号子义

entries.definition: a district of shanties, built from shanty and town
entries.definitionCN: 棚户区；由 shanty 与 town 复合而成

entries.definition: a small simple shelter
entries.definitionCN: 小屋；棚屋

entries.definition: a poor and overcrowded district of a city
entries.definitionCN: 贫民窟；贫民区

entries.definition: a small simple wooden house
entries.definitionCN: 小木屋；简陋木房

normalIntro.en: Shanty is the camp hut of a lumber yard, and its cousins name the people and the district around it.
normalIntro.cn: shanty 本是木料场营地的工棚，它的近亲词则指它周边的人与街区。

normal.en: Shanty comes from a lumber camp, where rough huts sheltered the workers.
normal.cn: shanty 源自伐木营地，那里用粗糙小屋安置工人。

normal.en: A shantytown is shanty plus town, a place made of huts.
normal.cn: shantytown 是 shanty 加 town，即由棚屋组成的地方。

normal.en: In IELTS reading, shanty town is a common phrase for poor urban housing.
normal.cn: 在雅思阅读里，shanty town 常用来指城市的贫民住房。

normal.en: Compare shack, which also means a rough hut and shares the meaning, not the root.
normal.cn: 对比 shack：同样指简陋小屋，共享的是意义而不是词根。

normal.en: The sea shanty is an unrelated word for a work song, also spelled chantey.
normal.cn: sea shanty 指水手号子，是无关的另一个词，也拼作 chantey。

abstract.en: Picture a hut of tin sheets and planks, with a rope holding the door shut.
abstract.cn: 想象一间铁皮加木板的屋子，用一根绳子把门拴住。

abstract.en: Think of a hillside crowded with hundreds of such huts, smoke rising between them.
abstract.cn: 想象一面山坡上挤满几百间这样的屋，屋间升起炊烟。

abstract.en: Hear a rowing crew pulling together to one shouted verse: that is the other shanty.
abstract.cn: 听见一船人随一句喊唱歌齐力划桨：那是另一个 shanty。

examples.en: The family built a small shanty from old boards.
examples.cn: 这家人用旧木板搭了一间小棚屋。

examples.en: Many workers moved into a shanty town outside the capital.
examples.cn: 许多工人搬进了首都郊外的棚户区。

examples.en: The sailors sang a shanty as they hauled the sails.
examples.cn: 水手们一面升帆一面唱号子。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「山踢」——把铁皮棚屋搭在山坡上，一场大风就把它踢翻；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 cantherius（支架）→ 古法语 chantier（木料场、工地）→ 北美法语 chantier（伐木营地及工棚）→ 英语 shanty（棚屋）；表示船歌的 shanty 一般认为另出法语 chanter（唱）。

sensesIntro.en: Shanty first names one rough hut of a work camp, then a whole district made of such huts, and finally meets an unrelated homograph that names a song.
sensesIntro.cn: shanty 先指工地上的一间粗陋小屋，再指由这种小屋组成的整片街区，最后遇到一个指「歌」的、无关的同形词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a crooked hut nailed together from scrap boards.
core.cn: 核心意象：用废木板钉成的歪斜小屋。

branches.en: A single hut keeps the camp meaning in the round.
branches.cn: 单间小屋完整保留了营地的意思。

branches.en: Many huts together make a poor district.
branches.cn: 许多小屋聚在一起就成了贫困街区。

branches.en: A separate word with the same spelling names a work song.
branches.cn: 另一个同形词指干活时唱的号子。

branches.en: The hut and the district differ only in scale.
branches.cn: 小屋与街区只在规模上有差别。

branches.en: Two unrelated words share one spelling, so context decides.
branches.cn: 两个无关的词共用一个拼写，要靠上下文分辨。

intro.en: Shanty is a borrowed camp word, and English builds shantytown on it while keeping chantey for the song.
intro.cn: shanty 是从营地用语借来的词，英语在它之上造出 shantytown，同时保留 chantey 表示船歌。

latinIntro.en: Latin cantherius, a trestle or support, is generally proposed as the distant ancestor of the French camp word.
latinIntro.cn: 一般认为，拉丁语 cantherius（支架、支座）是法语营地用语的远祖。

items.example: Cantherius is the earliest proposed link.
items.exampleCN: cantherius 是提出的最早环节。

items.meaning: a yard, a site, a camp
items.example: Chantier is the direct French source.
items.exampleCN: chantier 是直接的法语来源。

items.example: Shanty names one hut.
items.exampleCN: shanty 指一间棚屋。

items.example: The plural is shanties.
items.exampleCN: 复数是 shanties。

items.example: Shantytown joins shanty and town.
items.exampleCN: shantytown 由 shanty 与 town 合成。

items.example: Chantey keeps the song word separate.
items.exampleCN: chantey 保留了独立的号子词。

items.example: The final -y is kept from the French form.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -y 承自法语形式。

items.example: The town part names a place.
items.exampleCN: town 部分用来指一个地方。
